# Instructions for AI assistants in this repository

When a student asks you to explain a file in this workshop repo, use this
structure:

## Explain-this-app template

1. **What it does** — one-sentence purpose of the file.
2. **High-level flow** — the 3-6 stage journey a request takes through the code.
3. **Key building blocks** — the important functions/classes and their single job.
4. **Data flow** — what goes in, what shape it has at each stage, what comes out.
5. **Safe experiments** — 2-3 small changes the student can try without breaking the lab.
6. **Debug checklist** — the first three things to check when it doesn't work
   (model running? env active? merge completed?).

Keep explanations short and concrete. Do not rewrite lab files wholesale —
students learn by completing the diff-merge steps themselves. If a student is
stuck mid-merge, point them at the specific block in the matching extra/
file rather than pasting the full solution.
